system.description:
The mage accelerates decay in an object, causing rope to fray, metal to rust, or a lock mechanism to seize and crumble. The effect targets non-living matter, hastening natural entropy to a chosen failure point. Successes determine how quickly and completely the target degrades.

Dice Pool: Wits + Occult (+1 die as a rote)

Adapted to M5 from M20 Entropy 2; mechanics paraphrased.
